mapper.select: /* MenuMapper.selectMenuList 전체 메뉴 목록을 정렬순번 순으로 조회 */ SELECT MENU_ID, COALESCE(MENU_NM, '') AS MENU_NM, COALESCE(UPPR_MENU_ID, '') AS UPPR_MENU_ID, ALIN_SEQ, COALESCE(MENU_TYPE_CD, '') AS MENU_TYPE_CD, USE_YN, COALESCE(PRGM_ID, '') AS PRGM_ID, COALESCE(RMK, '') AS RMK FROM TB_MENU_M ORDER BY ALIN_SEQ NULLS LAST, MENU_ID
mapper.update: /* MenuMapper.updateMenu 메뉴를 수정 */ UPDATE TB_MENU_M SET MENU_NM = #{item.menuNm}, UPPR_MENU_ID = NULLIF(#{item.upprMenuId}, ''), ALIN_SEQ = #{item.alinSeq}, MENU_TYPE_CD = NULLIF(#{item.menuTypeCd}, ''), USE_YN = #{item.useYn}, PRGM_ID = NULLIF(#{item.prgmId}, ''), RMK = NULLIF(#{item.rmk}, ''), FINA_REGR_ID = #{usrId}, FINA_REG_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE MENU_ID = #{item.menuId}
mapper.select: /* MenuMapper.existsChildMenu 하위 메뉴가 있는지 판별 */ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_MENU_M WHERE UPPR_MENU_ID = #{menuId})
